How sealing works ›

Add #SEALED to a text and pick the day: a birthday, a first day, a wedding, or "a hard day". Everyone can see that a sealed memory exists, but not what it says. It opens for your child on that day. A sealed letter can even come with a physical gift, mailed so it arrives on the day.
